steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
How to read this page opens a short guide to every box and label on this screen.
Blank = unknown, 0 = none. A blank is listed as missing and never counted as zero.
Enter the lease terms — the same boxes as lease economics.
A one-off at signing: ₹12 lakh legal and stamp duty — a cost you don't get back.
Cash at signing: fit-out ₹3 crore and moving ₹25 lakh.
Calculate & save — fixed, tested formulas, not AI.
Nominal rent is the quoted rate; effective rent spreads rent-free and escalation over the term.
Present value: the whole term in today's money. Peak cash: the most you are out of pocket.
Cash at signing: the deposit is marked refundable; fit-out, moving and fees are not.
Unknown items stay 'unknown' and are left out of the total — never guessed.
What-ifs: how much the present value moves if rent, escalation or fit-out change.
Quoted = from a landlord or partner document; Estimated = your own assumption. The label follows the number everywhere.
How we calculated this: the formula version and every step, so anyone can check the maths.
Each save is a version. Change any input and recalculate — earlier versions are kept, never overwritten.
Download deck makes an editable PowerPoint of these results for the client.
Everything you save is also listed here and on the Deal toolkit home under Recently updated.
